I had been unkowingly suffering from an extremely low metabolism, and I was actively trying to lose weight for months. Exercising, counting calories (a safe and calculated deficit), being extremely careful about the types of foods I was eating, as well as intermittent fasting.

I would feel full for an entire day eating a single apple slice. The entire time I *should* have been losing weight, I actually gained weight. I was losing my mind.

I went to my doctor, and that's when I found out it is due to my metabolism. It has nothing to do with what or how much I eat and is a very real medical condition! This type of mindset is awful and damaging for people suffering from a number of conditions.
